tools.name: trace_replay
tools.description: one member alone over the trace, no world

tools.name: trace_case
tools.description: the window to tick K as a case of the member's package

unit.description: a family's case: a unit it exercises (a consumer without it skips the case)

into.description: NAME.yaml: that file; any other name: the package's cases/ directory, the file surprise-<member>-<K>.yaml there; else stdout

tools.name: trace_blame
tools.description: who last moved what is missing or stale at tick K: the member's rule, the world, or a take (Blame first)

atoms.description: comma-separated: `atom` should hold, `atom 0` should not, `atom 3` should hold thrice

program.description: the member's .llp: with it the rules' effects are applied to the state; without, only the do-lines from each segment's checkpoint

tools.name: trace_count
tools.description: the cross-tab: the ticks on which ATOM holds, by the value of each --by atom at the same tick (Measure the class first; A norm with its domain)

atom.description: a pred name (any instance), or one ground atom with its parentheses

by.description: an atom to tabulate by: holds / absent, or a pred's instances present

member.description: the member whose state is read (the trace's one member when it has one)

program.description: the member's .llp: with it the rules' effects are applied to the state; without, only the do-lines from each segment's checkpoint

tools.name: trace_families
tools.description: exactly one of each family holds at every tick, and the flicker: a family or a rule toggling a-b-a-b (Exclusive family; Steady reading)

family.description: p,q,r: pred names of which exactly one holds; the program's declared families are read too

program.description: the member's .llp: with it the rules' effects are applied to the state; without, only the do-lines from each segment's checkpoint

tools.name: trace_holds
tools.description: every window where ATOM is held past N consecutive ticks, with the rules that fired within it (Bounded yield)

max.description: the ticks a hold may last

program.description: the member's .llp: with it the rules' effects are applied to the state; without, only the do-lines from each segment's checkpoint

tools.name: trace_diff
tools.description: two runs of the same command: the first tick where the fired rules differ, and where the state differs (Sim race in the log)

member.description: one member; else every member of the trace

program.description: the member's .llp: with it the rules' effects are applied to the state; without, only the do-lines from each segment's checkpoint

tools.name: trace_outcomes
tools.description: the windows of a commitment atom and how each ended: done, cancel, or neither (Time to spare; Committed action)

commit.description: the atom held while the action runs

program.description: the member's .llp: with it the rules' effects are applied to the state; without, only the do-lines from each segment's checkpoint

tools.name: trace_sort
tools.description: each response violation of a run's log, by why it is one: checker, projection, competing, responder, gap, unseen (Sort before rule)

log.description: the world's log: rows with tick, cmd, a, v, zone, danger, truth, seen_ids

shift.description: ticks from a row to its facts on the trace (the road's: 1)

bound.description: a response and its acceleration bound (the road's: brake_min=-4, brake_min_correct=-3)

holder.description: the mark in a pair id of a way the ego holds

cases.description: a directory: a surprise case per violation

tools.name: trace_fired
tools.description: how many of seeds 1..N the rule fires on when the member is replayed over the trace's inputs (Search the seeds for a firing)

rule.description: a rule's name, or one firing with its bindings: rule[X=a]

tools.name: lint
tools.description: shape findings over a program that compiles (patterns CHECKS.md §3); exit 1 with --strict when any fires
